metadata.description: OdbcTable dataset pointing at one IRIS table/view. Deploy one of these per table -- or use generator/generate_adf_templates.py to emit one per entry in a table list instead of copy-pasting this file by hand.

IRIS table name as SQL sees it, e.g. 'SQLUser.Patient' or 'Epic.Encounter'. Must be a table/view that a %All-role or explicitly-granted SELECT-privileged user can read (see ../README.md, the -400 fatal-error section).
